description: Returns the public price list: the value of one credit in USD and how the package price is tiered by word count. Use it for general pricing questions that have no concrete inputs. For the exact price of a specific analysis use qualitative_quote_analysis. No account needed. It does not change an account: credits are managed in the user's SurveysAI account on the website.
name: qualitative_get_pricing
title: Get public pricing
